newsitem.title: USA: Regulators to update utility merger rules - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Regulators to update utility merger rules - WSJ.

text.p: Federal Energy regulators are expected to adopt a long-awaited update to electric utility merger rules, The Wall Street Journal reported Wednesday.
Nine proposed transactions valued at $25 billion are hanging in the balance, the story says.
The Federal Regulatory Commission's first major revision of its 1960s era merger guidelines is expected to track standards being used by antitrust enforcers at the Justice Department, the story says.
The new rules could mean consumers will more quickly receive billions of dollars in lower rates that have been promised by proponents of major utility mergers, the story says.
